method.unit: complete review; n-grams and KWIC bounded by heuristic sentences
method.normalization: lowercase; retain hyphens, apostrophes and single-character tokens
method.stopwords: discard only n-grams whose tokens are all stopwords
method.frequency_denominator: all eligible bigram occurrences in the group before top-25 selection
method.labels: original annotations; not automatically validated linguistically
method.synthetic_dependence: AI reviews derive from real-labelled seeds and are not independent observations
